steps.caption: Merge k sorted lists: the next output value is the smallest current head. A min-heap holds one head per list.
Pop 1 (from list 0) and append it. Push list 0's next value (4).
Pop 2 (from list 1) and append it. Push list 1's next value (5).
Pop 3 (from list 2) and append it. Push list 2's next value (6).
Pop 4 (from list 0) and append it. Push list 0's next value (7).
Pop 6 (from list 2) and append it. Push list 2's next value (9).
The heap never holds more than k items: O(N log k) for N total values.
